about: Kapuskasing is a town in Cochrane District, northeastern Ontario, on the Kapuskasing River along the Highway 11 clay belt. A planned mill town with a distinctive civic layout, it remains a bilingual forestry and service centre in the boreal north. About 8,000 people live in Kapuskasing.
seoSummary: Northeastern Ontario mill town on the Kapuskasing River—planned bilingual Highway 11 service centre.
